**✨ Feature release** · Obsidian 1.11.4+ · desktop & mobile

M.I.L.A can now open straight into a fresh conversation when the panel starts, in the mode you choose.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **Start with a new chat**: Settings › Chat › "Start with a new chat" lets you pick Chat, Vault Q&A or Agent. When set, opening the panel drops you directly into a new conversation of that mode instead of the dashboard — handy for starting every session in Agent.
- **Dashboard is still the default**: leaving the option on "Dashboard" keeps the previous behavior — the panel opens where you left off.
- **Safe fallback**: an empty or unknown value (for example, from an older `data.json`) simply opens the dashboard; a stale setting can never strand you on a screen that does not exist.

### 🔧 Fixes & Quality
- New pure `startupMode()` helper, unit-tested; the settings tree and the pt-BR coverage tests were updated for the new row.
